specs.title: deleting the active space falls back, deleting the last one makes a fresh space
two spaces with the same name are both allowed (consistent in UI and API)
long and odd space names survive the round trip
relaunch restores spaces, active layout and lock
lock blocks add / close / move; unlock restores them
